exposure: availability of potable water at street
outcome: Seroprevalence of Toxoplasma gondii (T. gondii) infection
cohort: 311 pregnant women in Matehuala City, Mexico
finding: The seroprevalence of T. gondii infection in pregnant women in Matehuala City, Mexico was found to be low (4.2%) and associated with availability of potable water at street and being born outside of Mexico.
mod_finding: No association was found between T. gondii seroprevalence and history of caesarean section.
